report_title: SporeKart Enterprise Performance, Scalability & Reliability Validation Report

startup_time_estimate_ms.details: No code splitting at App.tsx level. All 200+ lazy imports initialized from single entry point. React.lazy with Suspense mitigates initial parse cost but all chunk definitions are in single file.

time_to_interactive_estimate.details: Single entry bundle with all routes

page_transitions.details: React.lazy + Suspense with skeleton fallback. Transitions are instant once chunks are loaded.

navigation_speed.details: Client-side routing with React Router. No full page reloads.

search_response.details: Search is client-side only (CommandPalette + filter arrays). No debounce on some search inputs.

rendering_speed.details: Most components use function components with proper hooks. Some inline styles in JSX cause recreation every render.

re_render_frequency.details: AppContext (activeRole, paletteOpen, sidebarOpen) re-renders all consumers on any change. No context splitting.

component_mount_time.details: Lazy loaded via React.lazy. Mount time should be acceptable for feature-sized chunks.

layout_shift.details: ShimmerLoader used in OrdersDashboard but not consistently. Auth success screen causes layout shift. No explicit width/height on images.

animation_smoothness.details: CSS animations preferred over JS. prefers-reduced-motion honored. transform/opacity animated only.

scroll_fps.details: Passive scroll listeners used. Non-passive touch events in ResizableDrawer may jank.

interaction_latency.details: Auth client has fixed 900ms delay. Some mock services use randomized delays. Debounced search missing in some filters.

dom_size.details: Admin tables render all rows without virtualization. Large datasets could exceed 5000+ DOM nodes.

local_storage_usage.details: No localStorage usage found in codebase

session_storage_usage.details: No sessionStorage usage found in codebase

findings: setTimeout in UploadPreview.tsx:95 without cleanup on unmount
setInterval in SessionTimeoutWarning.tsx:15 without cleanup on unmount
setInterval in ProgressPreview.tsx:17 without cleanup on unmount
Multiple setTimeout toast auto-dismiss patterns without cleanup refs
useCountdown hook in auth clears interval on start but may leak on rapid remounts
SelectPreview.tsx:129 uses setTimeout in onBlur without cleanup
All document.addEventListener calls have proper cleanup return functions in useEffect
ResizableDrawer cleanup is robust with document-level event cleanup
ColumnHeader.tsx cleanup pattern for mousemove/mouseup is correct
IntersectionObservers in Reveal, AnimatedCounter, TableOfContents, LegalTemplate all disconnect() properly
ResizeObservers in chart components all unobserve() properly
Requires runtime memory profiling with Chrome DevTools
Requires runtime profiling with React DevTools

overall.details: No real API integration exists. All data is mock/client-side. Network analysis requires backend integration.

api_count.details: No production API calls implemented in frontend

duplicate_requests.details: No real API calls to deduplicate

compression.details: Vite build uses default compression. No brotli or custom compression configured.

caching.details: No service worker. No cache headers configured. No HTTP cache strategy.

retry_behavior.details: Mobile core ApiClient has retry interceptor with exponential backoff. Not applicable to web-app (no API calls).

failed_requests.details: Error boundaries and error alert components handle UI errors gracefully.

overall.details: No virtualization, pagination, or infinite scroll patterns found in data-display components.

large_product_catalog.details: No product catalog data fetching or rendering optimization found

large_order_history.details: OrdersDashboard renders ALL orders in flat list. No pagination.

large_training_list.details: CourseLibrary renders all courses at once. No pagination.

large_admin_tables.details: Admin tables (ProductsPage, OrdersPage, etc.) render all rows. No virtualization.

large_search_results.details: GlobalSearch filters client-side array. No server-side search.

pagination.details: No pagination components used in data pages. DataGridPagination exists as component but not wired to any data source.

virtualization.details: No react-window, react-virtualized, or similar virtualization library found.

javascript_bundle_size.details: Requires 'vite build --report'. Estimated 1-2MB based on 3 dependencies + 200+ components.

css_bundle_size.details: Single global.css at ~675 lines plus auth.css at ~636 lines. Expected <50KB.

font_loading.details: System font stack (--font-family-sans). No custom font files to load.

code_splitting.details: React.lazy used for all routes. But all lazy imports defined in single App.tsx - 200+ chunks. Consider per-feature chunk grouping.

lazy_loading.details: React.lazy for all routes. loading='lazy' on

tree_shaking.details: ES modules with Vite. Tree-shakable imports. Only 3 runtime deps (react, react-dom, react-router-dom).

layout_thrashing.details: ResizableDrawer reads offsetWidth in handleMouseMove handler (line ~49-50) within the same frame as writes. Could cause forced reflows during resize.

forced_reflows.details: Inline style bindings like style={{ width: currentWidth + 'px' }} may trigger reflows. Not batched.

repaint_frequency.details: Requires runtime profiling with Chrome DevTools Paint Flashing

excessive_rendering.details: AppContext provides activeRole, paletteOpen, sidebarOpen. Changing paletteOpen triggers re-render of Header, Sidebar, CommandPalette, and all consumers. No context splitting.

unnecessary_state_updates.details: Toast state management uses setTimeout closures that may cause stale state issues. Multiple pages manage toast timer state independently.

long_session_results.notes: Long session testing (30/60/90 min) requires running application in browser with DevTools memory profiling. Cannot be performed via static analysis.
risk_factors: Timer leaks: setInterval in session timeout without proper cleanup on unmount or navigation
Context re-renders may accumulate listener registrations

stress_test_analysis.notes: Stress testing (rapid navigation, search, filtering, etc.) requires runtime execution. Cannot be performed via static analysis.

bugs.title: No data virtualization in admin tables or lists
Timer leak: setInterval in SessionTimeoutWarning with no cleanup on unmount
No pagination for orders, products, courses, or search results
No HTTP caching strategy, service worker, or offline support
AppContext causes excessive re-renders across all consumers
Inline styles in JSX recreate style objects on every render
Toast timeout setTimeout without proper cleanup refs
No preload/prefetch hints for critical routes
Layout thrashing: ResizableDrawer reads offsetWidth then writes in same frame
No bundle analysis or performance budget configured
Auth client has hardcoded 900ms latency with no timeout configuration
No React.memo on frequently re-rendered list items
Non-passive touch event listeners in ResizableDrawer may block scroll

recommendations: Implement windowing/virtualization for admin tables using react-window
Add pagination to OrdersDashboard, CourseLibrary, and admin data pages
Fix setInterval cleanup in SessionTimeoutWarning and ProgressPreview
Split AppContext into smaller contexts (AuthContext, UIContext) to reduce re-render scope
Extract inline styles to CSS classes or use styled-components for stable references
Configure Vite for bundle splitting and code-splitting by route groups
Add service worker with cache-first strategy for static assets
Add preload/prefetch <link> tags in index.html for critical routes
Fix ResizableDrawer to batch read/write operations to avoid layout thrashing
Add React.memo to list item components (EnterpriseOrderCard, product cards, etc.)
Add useDeferredValue for search/filter inputs to keep UI responsive
Replace setTimeout-based mock client with actual async patterns
Add bundle analysis to CI pipeline with size budgets
Configure web-vitals library for RUM performance monitoring
Add performance budgets to vite.config (chunk size warnings)
Set passive: true on touch event listeners in ResizableDrawer
